title: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: 铁观音(Tieguanyin)是中国最受欢迎的茶之一,原产于福建省安溪县西坪镇,如今安溪全县普遍种植，但该县不同地区生产的铁观音又各具风味。铁观音一年四季均可采摘,尤以春秋两季采摘的茶叶品质最佳。铁观音的加工非常复杂,需要专门的技术和丰富的经验。铁观音含有多种维生素,喝起来口感独特。常饮铁观音有助于预防心脏病、降低血压、增强记忆力。
reference: Tieguanyin, originating in Xiping Town, Anxi County, Fujian Province, is one of the most popular teas in China, and is now widely cultivated throughout Anxi County, while that produced in different parts of the county has its own distinctive flavor. It can be picked all year round, with those picked in spring and autumn being of the highest quality. The processing of Tieguanyin is highly complex, requiring specialized techniques and extensive experience. It contains various vitamins and has a unique taste. Drinking it regularly helps prevent heart disease, lower blood pressure, and improve memory.
